title: Diff-DiT: Temporal Differential Accelerator for Low-bit Diffusion Transformers on FPGA
problem: Diffusion Transformer inference has high computational cost and requires substantial memory for attention layers, limiting deployment on edge platforms like FPGAs.
method: FPGA accelerator using approximated differential attention (ADA) with significance scoring, optimal cross-cast data accessing patterns, and half-condition splitting dataflow to enable low-bit quantization.
key_novelty: First FPGA accelerator for low-bit Diffusion Transformer inference with temporal differential computation.
contributions: Approximated differential attention method for low-bit execution
Optimal cross-cast data accessing pattern with flexible reuse
1.39x throughput and 5.60x energy efficiency vs V100 GPU
